_source.verification_status: PENDING USER VERIFICATION. The posting asks for several years of compliance programme, audit and regulatory experience plus ISO 14001/50001; the sources support ISO self-training, gap analyses, environmental data and reporting, but not multi-site permit management, authority liaison or ISO 50001. Those are not claimed. To confirm: any permitting, inspection or authority-facing work.

name: Thomas Chacra
subtitle: Environmental Compliance Manager, Amazon (EAP France)
title: Bioengineer | Environmental compliance, permits & management systems
summary: Bioengineer who works at the point where environmental rules meet operating reality: permits, reporting obligations, management systems and the evidence file behind each declaration. I am comfortable with dense regulation and with the unglamorous work of keeping a site compliant across several regimes at once.

experience.title: Sustainability Adviser
experience.context: Compostable packaging and sustainable supply chains
bullets: Built a product carbon footprint model to ISO 14067 with explicit, traceable assumptions, defensible to an external reviewer.
Structured upstream environmental data, including international freight, to identify the levers that actually moved the result.

experience.title: ESG & Sustainability Analyst
bullets: Trained myself on ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 requirements and took part in training-aided gap analyses against those standards.
Built environmental performance indicators and monitoring routines used to spot deviations before they became non-conformities.
Controlled the quality of environmental datasets and documented the validation rules, so that every reported figure could be traced to its source.
Digitised a client audit trail with Power Automate, filing evidence into the correct folders and removing a manual workflow.

experience.title: Research and Development Scientist
bullets: Ran risk-aware analyses on energy and water data, and documented protocols so that results stayed reproducible across campaigns.
Worked with engineers and agronomists on resource-efficiency initiatives, turning measurements into operating rules.

experience.title: Energy and Environmental Consultant
bullets: Assessed environmental and regulatory constraints for energy projects, including compliance with regional building performance rules.

sidebar.heading: Key skills
paras:
Compliance: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001, gap analysis, evidence files, corrective action follow-up.
Environmental regimes: air, water, waste and energy reporting; GHG Protocol; ISO 14067.
Tools: Excel, Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, SQL, Python; MS Office suite.

sidebar.heading: Stakeholder work
paras: Working across technical and non-technical teams, suppliers and clients; writing procedures and explaining regulatory requirements to people who have to apply them.
